title: Seoul
sideASummary: Player deck back. Dark blue sunburst around a haven on the water. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Seoul, red Player card. Coordinates 37°33'57"N 126°58'41"E. The compass has an anchor, so the city is a port. One covered SEARCH box fills the map. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. Printed code P3-18b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Rebels in Seoul want to throw off Utopia. Immediately draw a free sea lane from Seoul to another city.

states.summary: Same Player back. The SEARCH box is scratched. Rebels in Seoul want to throw off Utopia. Immediately draw a free sea lane from Seoul to another city.

rules: Red Player card for Seoul. Port: the compass has an anchor.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is that box scratched. Side A stays the Player deck back.
When the box is scratched, immediately draw a free sea lane from Seoul to another city. The rebels line is the story. There is no named companion.
notes: Card id 10717. State 2 card id 10729. One copy.
Coordinates 37°33'57"N 126°58'41"E. Printed code P3-18b stays on the scratched face.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
No door number is printed in the box.
